adobo-seasoning.description:
Debbs Kitchen Adobo Seasoning is Salt Free!
Hand blended cumin, paprika, coriander, fennel, yellow mustard, garlic, onion, ancho, pasilla, and Mexican oregano. Rub or sprinkle on seafood and meat before grilling or frying.
Excellent in chili, guacomole, black beans, red beans, tacos, stews and sauces.

african-birdseye-chile-powder.description:
Debbs Kitchen African Birdseye Chile Powder is Salt Free!
A close relative of the fiery, hot habanero chile, ground from chiles grown in Uganda. Heat Level: 1000,000 -225000 Scoville Heat Units (SHU).
Excellent addition to soups, stews, vegetables, chicken, beef, lamb, pork dishes and sauces.

berbere.description:
Debbs Kitchen Berbere spice is Salt Free!
An Ethiopian favorite, hand blended from cumin, cardamom, allspice, fenugreek, coriander, cloves, black pepper, chili pepper flakes, cayenne pepper, ginger root, turmeric, salt, paprika and cinnamon. Berbere does pack some spiciness from the chile peppers but it is more flavorful than fiery hot.
Excellent in all dishes.

cajun-seasoning.description:
Hand blended Sea salt, Paprika, Garlic, Onion, Extra hot ground red chili powder, Thyme, White pepper, Black pepper, Oregano, Sage.
Great in all dishes.

chefs-blend-extra-virgin-olive-oil.description:
Debbs Kitchen single origin Australian Picual olives, Southern hemisphere extra virgin olive oil maintains a very well balanced tasting profile of fruitiness, bitterness, and pungency. This oil is moderately complex, a great all purpose olive oil that elevates your meals everytime. (200ml, 6.7floz)
Tasting Characteristics
Fruitiness: Medium
Bitterness: Mild
Pungency: Medium

chefs-reserve-balsamic-vinegar.description: Debbs Kitchen Chef’s Reserve Balsamic vinegar is made is made from selected Trebbiano and Lambrusco grapes using traditional Italian methods in producing a uniquely sweet and flavorful balsamic.

coarse-himalayan-pink-salt.description:
Debbs Kitchen Coarse Himalayan Pink Salt is mined by hand from the foothills of the majestic Himalayan Mountains, and harvested from ancient sea salt deposits.
Excellent in soups, stews, pasta, salads, vegetables, seafood and grains.
Store in a cool dark place to prevent clumping.

flippin-chicken.description:
Debbs Kitchen Flippin Chicken is Salt Free!
Hand blended from Paprika, Onion, Lemon, Honey, Sage, Marjoram, Ancho, Black pepper, Pasilla, Celery, Garlic, Cumin.
Excellent in all dishes.

garlic-powder.description:
Debbs Kitchen Garlic Powder is Salt Free!
Blended from California grown Garlic. Use 1/8 Teaspoon garlic powder to 1 fresh garlic clove.
Excellent with anything savory and works well in combination with just about all spices and herbs.

ginger-powder.description:
Debbs Kitchen Ginger Powder is Salt Free!
Our Ginger is light, with lemon pepper aura and the taste is sultry, intense and sharp.
Excellent in combination with sauces, salad dressing, stews, cardamom, cinnamon, paprika, pepper, nuts, dried fruits and any recipe that calls for Ginger.

ground-cumin.description:
Debbs Kitchen Ground Cumin is native to Northern Africa. It posseses a warm, spicy-sweet and somewhat bitter taste. It is Salt Free!
Excellent in combination with allspice, anise seed, brown mustard seed, cardamom, cinnamon, coriander, fennel seed, fenugreek seed, garlic, ginger, nutmeg, paprika, tumeric and yellow mustard seed.
Add Ground Cumin to tomato salsas to add depth to the natural sweetness of a tomato. Let it cook in with onions and garlic to create the base for an unforgettable black bean soup. It is a key ingredient in both Indian cuisine and Thai curries. Toss chickpeas in cumin and oil and roast to make chana, a healthy and delicious snack.

habanero-chile-powder.description:
Debbs Kitchen Habanero Chile Powder is Salt Free!
Blended from the hottest chile peppers and rates around 200,000 - 300,000 Scoville Heat Units (SHU). This spice is the real deal.
Excellent in homemade salsas, stews, sauces, barbeque and chicken wing sauce.

mediterranean-thyme.description:
Debbs Kitchen Aromatic Mediterranean Thyme Herb is carefully dried from fresh thyme plants. It is Salf Free!
Excellent when added to beef, lamb, chicken, fish, soups, stews, vegetables, egg and cheese dishes (like quiche, frittatas, and omelets), cabbage, carrots, fig, goat cheese, leeks, legumes, lentils, onions, peas, pork, potatoes, tomatoes and venison.
1 teaspoon of fresh thyme equals about 3/4 teaspoon of dried thyme.

ny-pizza-sauce-seasoning.description:
Debbs Kitchen NY Pizza Sauce Seasoning is Salt Free!
Hand Blended from Basil, Marjoram, Thyme, Rosemary, Savory, Sage, Oregano, Parsley.
Excellent in all dishes.

onion-powder.description:
Debbs Kitchen Onion Powder is Salt Free!
Ground from California-grown Onions.
Excellent in marinades, sauces, gravies, spice blends, canned foods, meats, spreads and soups.
Use 1-1/3 Tablespoon of powder in place of one fresh onion.

organic-maharajah-curry.description:
Debbs Kitchen Organic Maharajah Curry is Salt Free!
Flavorful Organic Maharajah Curry. Hand blended with organic cumin, turmeric, ginger, cayenne, coriander, yellow mustard, black pepper, fennel, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg and fenugreek.
Excellent addition to chicken, seafood, stews, sauces for rich color and flavor. Use generously in curry dishes.
Net Weight: 1/2 Cup Jar (2.6oz)

ras-el-hanout.description:
Debbs Kitchen Ras El Hanout is Salt Free!
Hand blended from Paprika, Brown mustard, Black pepper, Cumin, Grains of paradise, Tumeric, Coriander, Long pepper, Nigella, Caraway, Anise, Cardamom, Mace, Ginger, Korintje cinnamon, Lavender, Cubeb, Ajwain, Rose petals.
Excellent in all dishes.

suya-yaji.description:
Debbs Kitchen Suya Yaji Spice is Nigerian favorite spice mix hand blended from peanuts, sea salt, paprika, cayenne, garlic, ginger and onion.
Excellent in kabobs, vegetables, soups, stews, and anywhere you want a smoky peanut flavor.
Allergen warning: This product contains peanuts.
